About Nicole

The artist
behind the brand.

Nicole Vendettoli has built Envy Beauty on a single belief: that the best bridal makeup is the kind a bride barely knows she's wearing. Natural. Refined. Unmistakably her.

She specializes in the brides who wear little makeup in daily life and want to walk down the aisle looking like themselves on the most beautiful day of their lives.

Nicole brings a team of carefully chosen artists and stylists who share her standards, her eye, and her commitment. When you book Envy Beauty, you're booking into her world.
